Agent Name: Cubing_Expert  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: In step 3, Cubing_Expert incorrectly identified the missing cube colors as "Red, White." The analysis failed to consider that since all green corners and those that border yellow have been found, along with the fact that the opposite of orange cubes (red cubes) have been dealt with, a different combination must be missing. Upon reevaluation, taking into account the complete sets given (blue, adjacent orange, green corners, green bordering yellow), the colors of the removed edge piece must be "green" and "white," since they would have been the only pair not previously accounted for. This oversight in logic led to the incorrect solution being proposed.
